两个并行任务：d100 MMLU signals (GPU) + Cross-family Pooled IRT (CPU)。

服务器：cqa1-21977
环境：source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

## 任务 A: cuda:1 → d100 MMLU signals

```bash
source /etc/network_turbo
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache

# 检查模型路径
ls /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Llama-3.2-3B_d100_s42/merged/ 2>/dev/null && echo "MERGED" || ls /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Llama-3.2-3B_d100_s42/ | head -5

cd /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp002
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 nohup python compute_signals.py \
  --model-path /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Llama-3.2-3B_d100_s42/merged \
  --benchmark mmlu \
  --signal all \
  --output-dir /root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals/Llama-3.2-3B_d100_s42/ \
  --batch-size 4 \
  > /tmp/signals_d100_mmlu_cuda1.log 2>&1 &
echo "d100 MMLU signals PID: $!"
```

## 任务 B: Cross-family Pooled IRT (CPU, 后台)

```bash
cd /root/contamcal-irt-calibration
export TMPDIR=/root/autodl-tmp/tmp
mkdir -p $TMPDIR

# 检查脚本参数
python exp006/run_pooled_rrf_irt.py --help 2>&1 | head -30

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" nohup python exp006/run_pooled_rrf_irt.py \
  --exposure-scores /root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals/rrf/exposure_scores.json \
  --output-dir /root/autodl-tmp/exp006/results_cross_family_irt/ \
  --model 2pl_gamma \
  > /tmp/cross_family_irt.log 2>&1 &
echo "Cross-family IRT PID: $!"
```

如果参数格式不对（如 --exposure-scores 不是正确的 flag），看 --help 调整。可能需要 --scales 参数加入 Llama。

## 验证

```bash
sleep 15
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv,noheader
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader
ps aux | grep -E "cross_family_irt|run_pooled" | grep -v grep
for pid in $(nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid --format=csv,noheader); do echo "PID $pid: $(ps -p $pid -o args= 2>/dev/null | head -c 150)"; done
```

## 汇报

1. 任务 A PID + cuda:1 显存确认
2. 任务 B PID + 进程确认
